plain_language_conclusion: Move the next engineer-day from optional polish to payment validation; the canonical runtime decision carries the actual resource allocation.

candidate_horizon_probe.finding: Compared the active path, payment validation, maintenance, defer, stop, and reserve postures.
candidate_horizon_probe.failure_criteria_response: The active task did not own the candidate set merely because it was already in progress.
candidate_horizon_probe.evidence_surface: Canonical runtime packet and terminal decision reference.

priority_order.finding: Target feasibility and threshold necessity were considered before optional improvement.
priority_order.failure_criteria_response: The method did not use a single ROI-style score to delete a launch requirement.
priority_order.evidence_surface: Candidate assessments and cited acceptance evidence in the runtime decision.

resource_contention.finding: The compared actions contest the same declared engineer-time pool.
resource_contention.failure_criteria_response: Independent resource channels were not forced into one artificial rank.

evidence_bounded_necessity.finding: Necessity was bounded to the current target, evidence, assumptions, and release window.
evidence_bounded_necessity.failure_criteria_response: The claim records what would make the necessity obsolete.

contraction.finding: One bounded contraction identified what can leave the current allocation without breaking the target or risk floor.
contraction.failure_criteria_response: The result records a current floor rather than only comparing attractive tasks.
contraction.evidence_surface: Candidate contraction results and allocation ledger.

replenishment.finding: One next meaningful tranche was compared from the contracted floor.
replenishment.failure_criteria_response: The next allocation ends at an observable completion signal.
replenishment.evidence_surface: Typed next-tranche record in the terminal runtime decision.

meaningful_tranche.finding: The comparison unit is one bounded engineer-day producing a reproducible result.
meaningful_tranche.failure_criteria_response: The method did not split a threshold-dependent action into meaningless tiny units.
meaningful_tranche.evidence_surface: Typed quantity, window, and completion signal.

switching_vs_sunk_cost.finding: Future switching cost and reusable assets were separated from historical spend.
switching_vs_sunk_cost.failure_criteria_response: Past spend was not used as a reason to continue.
switching_vs_sunk_cost.evidence_surface: Situated state considerations and sunk-cost rejection field.

authorization_horizon.failure_criteria_response: Lite does not authorize an open-ended decision window.

defer_stop_or_reserve.finding: Displaced work and reserve consequences are explicit in the canonical allocation ledger.
defer_stop_or_reserve.failure_criteria_response: Zero-allocation work is not silently left active.
defer_stop_or_reserve.evidence_surface: Runtime candidate postures and reserve record.

rerank_trigger.failure_criteria_response: The decision has a bounded lifetime rather than permanent authority.

mode_boundary.finding: Lite is used for one bounded reversible tranche.
mode_boundary.failure_criteria_response: Full-only bundle, multi-resource, or irreversible conditions would require escalation or a governed override.
mode_boundary.evidence_surface: Runtime mode, escalation signals, and override record.

claim_ceiling.finding: The result is limited to the current allocation window.
claim_ceiling.failure_criteria_response: The fidelity pass does not claim correct priority, optimal ROI, or real-world business value.
claim_ceiling.evidence_surface: Runtime claim ceiling and this method-fidelity contract.
